name: App Shell & Routing
description: Frontend bootstrap, root React app, window management, router, and HTML entry points.

name: Feature Modules
description: Large product areas under src/modules (WorkStation, MainApp, ProjectManager, etc.).

name: Domain Engines
description: Core interactive engines under src/engines (ChatPanel, SessionCore, Simulator, Browser/Terminal/Database cores).

name: Feature Widgets
description: Composable feature units under src/features (Org2Cloud, SessionCreator, Kanban, CodeMirror, etc.).

name: UI Scaffold & Components
description: Reusable UI framework and shared components: scaffold (Spotlight, Wizard, Navigation, Modal), components, assets.

name: State & Hooks
description: Client state management and cross-cutting hooks: store (Jotai atoms), hooks, contexts, ActionSystem.

name: API & Services
description: Frontend service and Tauri-bridge layer: api (RPC/HTTP clients), services, lib, diagnostics.

name: Shared, Types & Utils
description: Cross-cutting utilities, type definitions, shared helpers, frontend config, and test harness.

name: Rust Backend (Tauri)
description: The entire Rust/Tauri backend under src-tauri: crates (agent-core, orgtrack, git, lsp, browser, ...), commands, proto, and native config.

name: Docs, Config & Tooling
description: Documentation, build/dev scripts, monorepo packages, CI/hooks, archived code, and root project configuration.
